name: Easy Slow Cooker Indian Spiced Coconut-Lentil Stew with Tomato, Spinach & Naan

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
2 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a 4-quart slow cooker insert.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the insert with the carrots. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the insert.
Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and add to the insert along with broth, tomatoes, and spices. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups green lentils, dried
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 (411 g) can diced tomatoes
1 tsp salt
1 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp turmeric, ground

instructions.primary_message: Cover and cook until lentils and veggies are tender, about 8 hours on low or 4 hours on high.
When the stew is done, add spinach to the insert in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Add coconut milk to the stew, stir to combine, and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 30 minutes on low or 15 minutes on high.
Divide stew between bowls and serve with naan on the side. Enjoy!
